articles.text: Within the meaning of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689, the requirements set out in Chapter III, Section 2, of that Regulation shall be taken into account.

provenance: Regression vector for the AI Act's own frequent self-citation (Art. 102-109 in the real corpus each cite 'Regulation (EU) 2024/1689', which IS the AI Act) — a clause naming ONLY the citing instrument itself produces NO record at all.
